scope: Local source and existing receipts only; no SSH, GPU, Git, model load or new gate. Sole written artifact is this JSON.
decision: CONTINUE r9114b on existing authorized runtime path. No source blocker found in the shadow-length fix. First actual partial replay and subsequent verify remain runtime evidence, not startup prerequisites added by this review.
root_cause: r9114a replay corrected recurrent shadow state and PairState but did not crop InferEngine::kimi_native_lengths_. Actual freeze_input requires read length == past; original verify commits shadow to past+full_width. After row swap the next input was rejected by stale full-width shadow ledger.
fix_evidence: ProbeEngine::state_control_r9114 lines29-34 holds submission_mutex_, checks distinct bounded read/write, positive past, 1<=retained<verified_width<=8, read_length=past and shadow_length=past+verified_width before owner submission.

All submitted owners are waited even when a later submission fails; any first exception rethrows before length commit. All8 owners and typed7-word stats are required before setting only shadow_length=past+retained.

modern_kimi_state_replay_r9114 line263 checks phase3, retained prefix bounds, original epoch past and cached width; allocates prefix before mutation; calls PairState.completed only after owner replay and ledger commit. PairState completed then swaps active/shadow and advances past.
Begin/Clear keep verified_width default0; Replay-only validation does not reject these calls. Fullaccept and ordinary AR code unchanged by a-to-b source diff.

Lock order is pair_mutex -> context mutex -> submission_mutex -> short worker mutex acquisition. Worker processing releases worker mutex and does not acquire outer locks. No introduced reverse order found.
Worker uses appended typed STATE_BEGIN/REPLAY/CLEAR commands. Handler is separate from RUN and invokes owner-local state functions without Model forward or PP collectives.

Cached read/write metadata are owner-allocated tensors kept with cached activations; replay validates epoch/past and state-pool pointers on owner thread. Payload stack words remain alive through wait of every submitted owner.

Runtime target_protocol checks CAPI success and cross-host replay collection before z.extend/row completion. verify_emit only records event/timestamp locally; command failure does not append a successful committed cycle.
remaining_risks: Partial owner failure can leave shadow recurrent state partially changed. It does not crop CPU ledger or swap PairState; failed worker or consumed cache rejects reuse. Existing runtime failure handling must end that attempt; rollback/retry is not proven and not required for this startup.
Review establishes source transaction ordering, not full-Model math correctness or actual speed. Component replay savings cannot be extrapolated to end-to-end throughput.
Private API is serialized single caller. Concurrent mode/replay invocation and mid-epoch Clear recovery are outside exercised harness.
Real first partial rejection -> next verify/width1 continuation, all-owner activation, natural completion and broader heldout quality remain unmeasured for b.

policy.early: Reasonable task outputs and correct answers; no exact token identity or F64 requirement.
policy.late: Real matched heldout benchmark, coverage, task scores and uncertainty; small math smoke is insufficient for no-degradation.
